<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex38032023-09-181" status="unreviewed" ana="corpusmd:colophon"><lb n="102a4"/> <rs type="person" ana="">dgra bcom pa chen po sa ga'i lha</rs>s <?oxy_comment_start comment="Visakhadeva, P7673"?><?oxy_comment_end?><anchor xml:id="a1"/> mdzad pa'i <rs type="work" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4735">'dul ba'i bstan bcos me tog phreng rgyud kyi TI ka bla ma'i legs bshad rgya cher bshad pa legs bshad rgya mtsho</rs> zhes bya ba <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4123">bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa dka' bzhi pa shes rab seng ge</rs>'i <anchor xml:id="a2"/> gsung la [b]rten nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4005">mang du thos pa bsaM <lb n="102a5"/> gtan bzang po</rs>s rnam g.yengs spang te <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference">ston pa </rs>myang ngan las 'das nas <hi rendition="#Time">lo sum stong bzhi brgya dgu bcu rtsa gsum pa'i dus</hi> su | <hi rendition="#Time">gdong ngan gyi lo sa ga'i dkar phyogs tshes brgyad<anchor xml:id="a3"/> </hi>la <rs type="place" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4411">dpal snar thang gi gtsug lag khang chen po</rs>r rdzogs par sbyar ba'o ||
         'di la brten nas sems cad thams cad kyis blang dor gyi gnas rtogs nas | 'jug ldog phyin ci ma log par byas te rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sar bsgrod par gyur cig |</seg></TEI>
